name: Regie.ai
tagline: AI sales engagement platform that automates outbound prospecting.
description: Regie.ai is an AI-native sales engagement platform whose AI agents handle outbound prospecting — sourcing and enriching contacts, writing personalized messages, and running multichannel sequences across email, phone, and social — while human reps focus on live conversations. Its RegieOne platform unifies enrichment, a parallel dialer, sequencing, and reporting in one workflow.
insight: Raised a $30M Series B in Feb 2025 and launched RegieOne, repositioning from an AI content tool into a full AI sales engagement platform.
edge: Combines autonomous prospecting agents with a built-in parallel dialer and sequencer in one platform, rather than bolting an AI SDR onto a separate SEP.

references.title: Regie AI Review 2026: Worth It for Outbound Personalization?
